params.1273: Hack back the encroaching jungle to protect the village of Tai Bwo Wannai.
params.1292: Gives favour, which can be exchanged for trading sticks used to purchase goods and access to hardwood.
params.1274: You may play this minigame as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to Murcaily, on the east side of Tai Bwo Wannai, to learn more.
params.1276: You will be attacked and may be poisoned while hacking back the jungle.
